create_DepthCovEstimator: create a DepthCovEstimator instance from a config dict with model_path, device, level, and std_valid_threshold
run_query_sparse_depth: run query on an RGB image with sparse depth and train/test coordinates to get predicted depth and validity mask
run_query_tensor_sparse_depth: run query_tensor on an RGB tensor with sparse depth and train/test coordinate tensors to get predicted depth and validity
run_estimate_depth: run estimate_depth on a batch of RGB images and depth maps to predict full depth using Gaussian process conditioning
run_sample_coords: run sample_coords on a depth tensor to randomly sample coordinate and depth value pairs for training
